zh-CN.title: 投稿邀请状态优化
items: 邀请成员时会明确区分已加入和等待确认，并显示待确认邀请的有效期
发送邀请按钮移动到更清晰的右侧主操作位置，并显示当前选择人数

en.title: Clearer submission invitations
items: The member picker now clearly separates joined members from pending invitations and shows invitation validity
The send invitation action is easier to find on the right and shows the current selection count
